## Source

Nevada Division of Environmental Protection  
https://nevadawaterquality.ndep.nv.gov/

---

## Station Selection

Current ingestion is restricted to the following station codes:

SB7, SB44, SB33, SB40, SB42, SB5, SB6, SB3, SB10, SB8, SB20, SB46,  
STBT03WHITES-2, STBT03Thomas-4, STBT02Steamboat-2a

---

## Parameter Groups

Select only:
- FIELD – Field
- GENERAL – General
- METAL – Metal

---

## Required Files

Place the following CSVs in this folder:
- `StationData.csv`
- `NormalizedData.csv`

Do not edit these files after download.
